title: readContractHistory
responsibility: Reads contract-only snapshot differences and first-parent committed history with immutable blob reuse, stable identity following, commit attribution and material-change filtering.

inputs.name: readContractDiff.revisions
inputs.description: Zero selectors for HEAD to working tree, one range or commit selector, or two explicit revisions; a lone commit compares its first parent or the empty root base.

inputs.name: readContractDiff.options
inputs.description: Project root, identity/path/kind/area and field filters, snapshot selectors, output mode and limits. Diff counts precede display limits; log limits matching commits.

inputs.name: readContractLog.unit
inputs.description: Unit id or stable uid to follow through committed history; an empty string selects every contract permitted by the other filters.

inputs.name: readContractLog.options
inputs.description: Project root, identity/path/kind/area and field filters, snapshot selectors, output mode and limits. Diff counts precede display limits; log limits matching commits.

inputs.name: readContractLog.last
inputs.description: When true, stops at the latest material matching commit and rejects an empty result; otherwise log defaults to twenty matching commits.

outputs.name: readContractDiff
outputs.description: Contract-only snapshot comparison with resolved snapshot labels, semantic changes, ignored files and full filtered counts before the display limit.

outputs.name: readContractLog
outputs.description: First-parent material contract changes with commit, author, date and subject. Uses stable uid or unchanged id, excludes formatting-only commits and reports unscanned candidates.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Invalid roots, revisions, contracts, selectors or filters propagate; last also rejects a history with no matching material change.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Filesystem and Git read failures propagate their diagnostics; no registry or source writes are performed.
